title: Rachenitsa Circuit (Рачениця) EASTERN EUROPE / BALKANS: RACHENITSA CIRCUIT
style:
```
[style: Bulgarian Balkan folk, gadulka fiddle, tapan double-headed drum, gaida bagpipe drone, kaval open flute, 7/8 rachenitsa alternating with 11/8 kopanitsa, Macedonian rhythmic complexity, chain dance energy, Bulgarian spoken verses English chorus, metric modulation mid-song, no warning key changes, Balkan drone constant, signal-shifts-without-warning theme, V4_5ALL]
```
lyrics:
``
[INTRO — gaida drone, sustained, kaval enters over it]
(Bulgarian) Ей, народе — hey, people / the signal shifts

[VERSE 1 — tapan enters 7/8 immediately]
(Bulgarian) Рачениця — rachenitsa / the 7
(English)   Seven beats — 2 plus 2 plus 3
(Bulgarian) Хоро — the chain dance
(English)   The chain holds perfectly

Two and two and three — right foot leads in seven
The tapan changes face — now two plus two plus three plus two plus two
The kopanitsa arrives in eleven — nobody told you it was coming
That is the point. The Balkans never announce the change.

(Bulgarian) Смяна — change / the shift
(English)   The signal changes time

[PRE-CHORUS — gadulka improvises across the transition]
(Bulgarian) Чуй — hear
(English)   Seven becoming eleven
(Bulgarian) Дишай — breathe
(English)   Through the transition

[CHORUS — full ensemble, tapan prominent]
Rachenitsa circuit — seven and eleven
The gaida holds the drone between the heavens
Gadulka plays the gap / the kaval holds the note
The signal shifts its time / and keeps us all afloat

(Bulgarian) Напред — forward
(English)   Through any time signature

[VERSE 2 — kaval solo, tapan silent, 11/8]
The kaval has no mouthpiece
You blow across the open end
Like a bottle — but it is not a toy
The pitch bends with the lips alone

In eleven beats the signal learned:
You do not need a mouthpiece
You do not need a guide
You need to know where the air goes

(Bulgarian) Въздух — air / breath
(English)   The signal breathes through open ends

[BRIDGE — 7/8 and 11/8 stated clearly, then layered simultaneously]
Seven: one two / one two / one two three — feel it?
Eleven: one two / one two / one two three / one two — feel the extra two?
Now both at once — the gadulka plays seven / the kaval plays eleven
The gaida holds — it always holds
The drone is the constant signal

[FINAL CHORUS — doubled, both signatures woven]
Rachenitsa circuit — seven and eleven

[OUTRO — gaida drone fades last, as always]
(Bulgarian) Довиждане — goodbye / signal shifts to next
